title: WIZ CLOUD – ENVIRONMENTS & SECURITY CATEGORIES
description: AWS finding records by account and source category. Risk Issues are risk/threat issues; Posture Issues are posture issues and CLOUD_CONFIGURATION issues; Vulnerability Management counts individual active AWS vulnerability findings (Critical through Low). These sources have different granularities and totals must not be interpreted as unique affected resources. CI/CD is explicitly unavailable, not zero. Historical snapshots begin at deployment, with no fabricated backfill.

list.name: environment
list.label: AWS Environment
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT subscription_name FROM wiz_active_issues ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT subscription_name FROM wiz_active_issues ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Collection Coverage & Freshness
panels.description: Check availability and timestamps before interpreting counts. Failed syncs retain the previous committed data. CI/CD unavailable is not a genuine zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT category AS "Category", CASE WHEN available THEN 'Available' ELSE 'UNAVAILABLE' END AS "Coverage", last_success_at AS "Last successful collection", detail AS "Details" FROM wiz_collection_status ORDER BY category;

panels.title: Vulnerability Management
panels.description: OPEN AWS vulnerability finding records. All Critical/High/Medium/Low findings are collected.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT available FROM wiz_collection_status WHERE category = 'Vulnerability Management') THEN COUNT(*) ELSE NULL END AS "Open findings" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category = 'Vulnerability Management' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring});

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT available FROM wiz_collection_status WHERE category = 'Risk Issues') THEN COUNT(*) ELSE NULL END AS "Open issues" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category = 'Risk Issues' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring});

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT available FROM wiz_collection_status WHERE category = 'Posture Issues') THEN COUNT(*) ELSE NULL END AS "Open issues" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category = 'Posture Issues' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring});

panels.title: CI/CD Scans
panels.description: Unavailable for this API client: read:security_scans is missing. Scan executions are not counted as findings.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT available FROM wiz_collection_status WHERE category = 'CI/CD Scans') THEN COUNT(*) ELSE NULL END AS "Open findings" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category = 'CI/CD Scans' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring});

panels.title: Categories by AWS Environment
panels.description: OPEN findings per account. CI/CD is unavailable and omitted, not assumed zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT subscription_name AS "Environment", category AS "Category", COUNT(*) AS "Open findings" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY subscription_name, category ORDER BY subscription_name, category;

panels.title: Severity Breakdown by Category
panels.description: Critical, High and Medium OPEN findings; also respects the selected severity filter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT category AS "Category", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'CRITICAL') AS "CRITICAL", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'HIGH') AS "HIGH", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'MEDIUM') AS "MEDIUM" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND severity IN ('CRITICAL', 'HIGH', 'MEDIUM') GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;

panels.title: Category Trends Over Time
panels.description: Actual periodic OPEN-finding snapshots; history starts with the first successful expanded sync. No historical backfill and no zero fill for unavailable sources.

targets.rawSql: SELECT captured_at AS "time", category AS metric, SUM(issue_count)::double precision AS value FROM wiz_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(captured_at) AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY captured_at, category ORDER BY captured_at, category;

panels.title: Top Triggered Rules by Category
panels.description: Top 10 category/rule pairs ranked by current OPEN finding count. Vulnerability rules are the vulnerability finding names (typically CVEs).

targets.rawSql: SELECT category || ' | ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(rule_name, ''), '(unnamed)') AS "Category / Rule", COUNT(*) AS "Open findings" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY category, rule_name ORDER BY "Open findings" DESC, category, rule_name LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Filtered Findings Table
panels.description: Up to 1,000 most recent matching OPEN findings, ordered by creation time. Stat panels and charts count all matching findings, not just this table's display limit.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at, subscription_name AS "Environment", category, severity, rule_name, resource_name, resource_type FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST, id LIMIT 1000;
